title: The Dragon Alliance
prompt:
Character bible:
Children (draw these the same way on every page):
- Elliott, age 4–5, short straight light-brown hair; big gray-blue eyes; round cheeks; friendly adventurous expression, wearing medieval tunic with belt and boots or casual explorer outfit
- Colette, age 2–3, wavy brown hair in a top knot; large gray-blue eyes; soft cheeks, wearing whimsical princess-meets-adventurer dress with floral or heart motifs
Pets (draw these the same way on every page):
- Winnie, a Chihuahua–Pug mix, tan fur; upright ears; curled tail; small size
Keep these characters consistent. They represent specific real children. Do NOT replace them with generic children or idealized animated characters. Preserve their recognizable facial structure.

GLOBAL SAFETY (IMPORTANT):
- No object intersections or impossible overlaps.
- Clean occlusion: if objects overlap, the front object clearly covers the back object.
- No extra limbs, no duplicated faces, no merged hands/feet.
- Keep dragons anatomically clean: one head, two wings (if winged), four limbs, one tail.
- Keep shapes simple and readable for coloring.

Black-and-white children's coloring-book line art with clean black outlines on white background, no shading, gray, gradients, shadows, or large filled-black areas; interiors open for coloring. Classic coloring-book illustration style with natural child proportions and clear, expressive but restrained facial expressions. Full-page composition with medium-close framing; Elliott, Colette, and Winnie fill approximately 70–85% of page height, cropped closely to avoid large blank sky. Scene features a large flame dragon standing proudly at center with wings raised in a wide V shape. Elliott and Colette stand confidently in front of the flame dragon, one slightly ahead of the other, with Winnie standing between them. In the background, three other dragons—a forest dragon, an ice dragon, and a cloud-serpent dragon—perch separately on tall rock spires arranged in a wide arc behind the central flame dragon. Each dragon is clearly separated with no overlapping wings between dragons. Clear foreground, midground, and background separation using outlines only; balanced composition with no clutter and all characters fully visible and clearly readable.

Use the attached character sheet reference images as the canonical identity and style.
